scope: Independent source review of workspace-correct Source recognition; no live browser execution
confirmed: Guest lookup returns none before a docproc read (queries.ts:623).
Missing or unreadable device organization returns unknown before a docproc read; a selected organization is an exact organization_id predicate (queries.ts:629-655).

The recognition hook subscribes to organization storage changes, immediately invalidates old lookups, clears the old claim, and rechecks the current URL. Cleanup unsubscribes from both organization and broadcast listeners (use-page-recognition.ts:31-100).
PAGE_ALREADY_CAPTURED has no organization identity; the hook treats it only as a recheck trigger, so the payload id cannot directly restore an old Source (use-page-recognition.ts:88-100).
The Scrape missing-workspace banner uses the typed organization_unselected cause and shows a selection remedy. It does not render arbitrary backend reason text (ScrapeView.tsx:235-253).

The red guard failed the two missing/unreadable organization cases while its guest and selected-organization controls passed; source-org-red-001.json records that result. source-org-green-001.json records 13 passing tests before the later broadcast change.

findings.title: A local Saved claim survives a workspace switch
findings.evidence: ScrapeView.tsx:84-87 owns independent saved/savedSource state. It sets both after handleSave (lines 180-190), and its only clearing paths are recapture, URL navigation, edits, or another save. There is no organization-change subscription. After saving a Source in workspace A, switching to B on the same URL clears usePageRecognition but leaves the Save button reading Saved and leaves Open this Source pointing to A's id (lines 669-686). A save promise that resolves after the switch can also set these old-workspace values late.
findings.required_repair: Bind the local save confirmation and its Source id to the organization that received the save. Clear or invalidate them immediately on organization change, and reject a late save completion from an earlier organization. Cover same-URL switch and late completion with a focused guard.
